Subject: Personal Loan Application – Jeffery Day

Dear Loan Officer,

I am writing to formally apply for a personal loan. My name is Jeffery Day, and I am a 56-year-old senior project manager at a construction firm, where I earn an annual income of $95,000. I have held a stable career in my field, supported by my bachelor's degree in civil engineering, and I have been employed consistently throughout my professional life.

I own my home at 11853 Little Fords, North Geraldland, DE 59776, with a remaining mortgage balance of $120,000. I live there with my wife, Linda Day, and our two children, and we are currently preparing for the arrival of a new child.

The purpose of this loan is to help cover the anticipated expenses associated with our growing family. We have estimated the yearly cost of caring for our new child at approximately $12,000, which includes a $5,000 budget for essential baby items, in addition to an increase in our health insurance premiums of $200 per month once the baby is added to our policy. A personal loan would allow us to comfortably manage these upfront costs while we continue to build our savings ahead of the birth.

I would like to request a loan in the range of $10,000, with a repayment term that can be structured over three to five years. Given my steady income, established homeownership, and long employment history, I am confident in my ability to meet the repayment obligations on schedule.

I would be happy to provide any supporting documentation you may require, including recent pay stubs, tax returns, employment verification, and my current mortgage statement. Please let me know the next steps in the application process and what additional information you need from me.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,
Jeffery Day
11853 Little Fords, North Geraldland, DE 59776
